# Fun Factory Play Café — LLM site summary
# https://funfactoryplay.ca

> Fun Factory Play Café is an indoor playground and birthday party centre in Pickering, Ontario, with on-site Littles & Lattés Café. Unlimited drop-in play, private party packages, and a toddler-friendly play floor at 1420 Bayly St., Unit 15, Pickering, ON L1W 3R4.

## Contact (NAP)
- Name: Fun Factory Play Café
- Address: 1420 Bayly St., Unit 15, Pickering, ON L1W 3R4, Canada
- Phone: (647) 824-8389
- Email: info@funfactoryplay.ca
- Website: https://funfactoryplay.ca
- Café brand: Littles & Lattés Café (same location)

## Hours (effective September 8, 2026)
- Monday & Wednesday: 9:30 am – 2:30 pm
- Tuesday & Thursday: 12:00 pm – 7:30 pm (50% off drop-in admissions after 3:30 pm)
- Friday–Sunday: 9:30 am – 8:30 pm

## Drop-in admissions (pay at desk, unlimited play time)
- Under 1: $5.00 (free with paying sibling)
- Ages 1–3: $10.00
- Ages 4–13: $14.00
- Ages 14–17: $10.00
- Access 2 Card holders: $2 off drop-in admission rates

## Party packages (September 2026 pricing)
- Fun Party: $399 (10 kids, 10 adults)
- Active Fun Party: $499 (15 kids, 15 adults)
- Supreme Fun Party: $599 (20 kids, 20 adults)
- Extreme Fun Party: $699 (30 kids, 30 adults)
- Ultimate Fun Party: $999 Mon–Thu / $1,499 Fri–Sun (up to 50 kids, private facility)

## Policies
- Socks required for children and adults ($3 at reception)
- Signed waiver required before entry
- Parent supervision required
- Nut-free outside food allowed; no outside drinks
- Tue/Thu discount visits do not earn loyalty points

## Google reviews
- Approximately 4.3 stars, ~680 reviews
